name: Payfold
summary: An HR dashboard for staff, work hours and pay, with a live pay run, payslips and leave
about: A seven-page people and payroll app for HR teams, styled like warm paper and ink. Manage the staff directory, edit weekly timesheets and approve them, then review, approve and pay the monthly run and open a printable payslip for anyone. The overview shows a pay ribbon where gross pay flows into net pay, tax, fund and advances.
how: Open a page from the numbered sidebar; on a phone use the menu button.
On Overview, watch the pay ribbon split gross pay into net, tax, fund and advances; switch the hours chart between 7D, 30D and 12M.
On People, search, filter by team, sort columns and click a row to open a profile with hours and pay tabs; add, edit or remove people.
On Hours, step through weeks, click any day to change the hours, approve timesheets and clock people in or out on the live clock.
On Pay, click a row to add a bonus, advance or unpaid days, approve the run, then pay it and open or print any payslip.
On Leave, approve or decline requests (balances update) and see who is off in the next 14 days; Settings has theme, data download and reset.
